description: This file defines the NodeViewsData class for Drupal, providing views integration and data configuration for node entities, including methods for constructing the class, creating instances, retrieving views data, and identifying node access modules.

classes.name: NodeViewsData
classes.description: Provides views data configuration for Drupal node entities, including methods for constructing, creating instances, retrieving views data, and managing node access modules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for NodeViewsData, initializes dependencies and sets module extension list, with deprecation warning if not provided.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of NodeViewsData using a service container and entity type.

methods.name: getViewsData
methods.description: Returns configuration array for views integration, including fields, filters, sorting, and search capabilities for node entities.

methods.name: getNodeAccessImplementations
methods.description: Retrieves list of modules implementing node access hooks, used to control content access.
